title: Algebraic Constraint
text: Constrain input signal, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Solver} sets Algebraic Loop Solver; {Constraint}, {Tolerance} and {Initial Guess} sets the initial guess of solution value. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: f(z)
ports.summary: Input signal real scalar or vector

ports.name: z
ports.summary: Output state real scalar or vector

params.name: Constraint
params.values: Constraint on input signal f(z) = 0 (default) | f(z) = z

params.name: Solver
params.values: Algebraic Loop Solver auto (default) | Trust region | Line search

params.name: Initial Guess
params.values: Initial guess of solution value 0 (default) | scalar
